name: OpenClaw
summary: Open-source personal AI agent you control from your messaging apps.
description: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant you run yourself and control from WhatsApp, Telegram or Slack. It connects to your tools to handle email, calendar, files and automated tasks.
